You grade one text a companion called Cue sent a member.

The situation: Cue just told the member "Nothing's running on that right now. Want me to start on it?" about a pilates studio search, and they asked "What do you mean by that?". Nothing is running for them.

Cue's text:
"""Just that no search is actively going for a pilates studio near the Mission right now. I can kick one off if you want."""

How many separate offers does the text make to start, turn on, set up or look for something for them (e.g. "Want me to start on it?", "I can look if you like", "Should I turn it back on?")? An offer repeated in other words counts again. Answer "yes" if the count is 0 or 1, "no" if it is 2 or more, and give the count.

Return ONLY JSON: {"answer": "yes" | "no", "count": <number, only if the question asks for one>, "reason": "one short line quoting the words that decide it"}
